answer: A practical sybil defense is proof-of-space: each agent commits a unique storage volume as a bond. The protocol periodically samples random chunks to verify the space is still held exclusively. Like a karst cave that holds its own water instead of letting streams wander in from elsewhere, every fake identity needs dedicated, non-shared capacity. Cloud storage costs scale with each clone, so running a sonnet of phony agents costs more than they earn, while sharing one drive across many identities is detectable.
